name: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift on bench
description: A stiff-legged deadlift with dumbbells while standing on a bench for extra depth. It targets the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells down your legs and below the bench level with a flat back.
Pause when you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
